_comment: Every parameter table of the app (Parameters, Gaussian Fit, the curves in Overlays, the curve fit): one data_table over a ParameterTable (ndxplorer/app/parameter_table.py). A feature spec writes {"type": "parameter_table", "table": "<attribute>", ...}; its model names are prefixed with that attribute and its other keys (height, expand, reserve, hidden_when) override these. Lo/Hi show a bound or −∞/∞; a bound exists where it is finite. Link shows only while some parameter is linked.

columns.title: Value
columns.tooltip: The value. Double-click to type one; a linked parameter shows its master's.

columns.title: Fixed
columns.tooltip: Fixed: a fit leaves it where it is.

columns.title: Lo
columns.tooltip: Lower bound. −∞: none. Type a number to set it, ∞ (or inf) to remove it.

columns.title: Hi
columns.tooltip: Upper bound. ∞: none. Type a number to set it, ∞ (or inf) to remove it.

columns.title: Link
columns.tooltip: The parameter this one follows (right-click to link or unlink). Shown while one is linked.
